subject: Private VPC architecture review / next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Chris Evans <chris.evans@acme.com>
Cc: Ava Martin <ava.martin@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC architecture review / next steps

Hi Chris / Ava,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from my side:
- Goal: private VPC deployment of Redwood Private for production ML inference (low-latency inference behind customer network).
- Key requirements called out: network peering options, KMS/HSM integration for keys, audit/log retention (SOC2), and on-prem gateway for air-gapped workloads.
- Success criteria: validated network design + runbook, defined attendee list for architecture review, and a follow-up timeline for procurement/provisioning.

Next step: let's schedule a 60-minute architecture review / technical deep dive with our solutions engineering and security lead to walk your network and deployment constraints and review a proposed topology.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Wed 6/30, 10:00–11:00
- Thu 7/1, 14:00–15:00
- Fri 7/2, 09:00–10:00

Can you let me know which slot works and who from your side should attend (networking, cloud security, procurement)? Also please confirm if you need an NDA in place before we share any architecture diagrams — we can get that over quickly.

Attaching a short one-pager of notes from today's discovery for reference (discovery-notes.pdf).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

- Chris Evans (CTO, network owner)
- Ava Martin (Cloud Security)
- Michael Liu (Platform eng) — may join if available.

Also please come prepared to cover: cross-account VPC peering vs. PrivateLink, KMS integration (bring-your-own vs. Redwood-managed), audit log retention windows, and an estimated timeline for Dedicated/Private onboarding.

I've attached our security questionnaire excerpt so you can see the high level asks (ACME-Security-Reqs.pdf).

- a proposed VPC topology (peering + PrivateLink + transit options)
- a baseline network diagram showing subnets, NAT/egress paths, and expected IP ranges
- a short runbook for onboarding (what we need from Acme: VPC IDs, CIDR ranges, who manages BGP/peering, egress IP allowlists)
